MORE THAN A SALON

Your place.

Say Yes is more than a beauty salon. It is an urban space for beauty and relaxation.

We created a place where switching off comes naturally: come for a beauty treatment, stay for coffee, meet friends or choose your next home-care favourite.

An experienced team, attention to detail and a warm, welcoming atmosphere help us deliver the result you expect — and make you want to return.

06 / OUR STORYFROM AN IDEA TO A COMMUNITY

Behind every yes —
a story.

The courage to start again, a love of the craft and a space that grew from one person’s idea into a lively community.

01 / the founder

The person behind the brand

Founded by Irina Gvozdeva, whose 14+ years in beauty, including work as a stylist and lead technologist at Wella Professionals, shaped a team and a place where professionalism, aesthetics and warmth meet.

02 / the journey

A time of change

Since 2022, two moves and two locations marked important chapters. Our 150 m² and 250 m² spaces saw us grow, open a bar and photo studio, bring people together and create the atmosphere that became part of our story.

03 / today

Our third home

A compact, thoughtfully designed space in central Saburtalo, built from scratch with our own hands in one of Tbilisi’s most convenient locations.

14+years in the beauty industry
